name: ask-shorty
description: Cited answers, field calculators, and exam prep from NEC 2026 for electricians.

interface.longDescription: Ask Shorty answers electrical code questions from the 2026 National Electrical Code. Each claim names the section it came from, and Shorty checks every section against the 2026 code text. Cited sections collect in a side panel so you can look them up in your code book or show the inspector. Run 16 field calculators, from voltage drop and box fill to conduit bending, and see each result with the sections it applies. Open the Ask Shorty app from the sidebar for calculators and exam prep with practice questions and chapter tests for all 9 NEC chapters. Set a default occupancy and units in settings. Ask Shorty is a reference tool, not professional advice. Check your adopted code and your AHJ.
defaultPrompt: How far apart do kitchen countertop receptacles go?
What's the voltage drop on 12 AWG copper, 120 V, 16 A, 75 ft?

positive.prompt: How far apart do kitchen countertop receptacles need to be?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer card shows checked section tags from 210.52(C), such as 210.52(C)(1), after the sentences they back. No code text is quoted.

positive.prompt: What size equipment grounding conductor for a 60 A circuit?
positive.expected_behavior: Answer card shows a checked tag for the governing Article 250 section. If it cites Table 250.122, the card shows only the 60 A row, labeled by column.

positive.prompt: Use Ask Shorty's calculator: voltage drop on 12 AWG copper, single-phase, 120 V, 16 A, 75 ft one way.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculator card shows the voltage drop in volts and percent, the steps, and a tag for the voltage drop informational note. No code text is quoted.

positive.prompt: Ask Shorty: I need a 6 inch offset with 30 degree bends. Where do I mark?
positive.expected_behavior: Calculator card shows the distance between bends and the shrink, with a Trade math tag and the note "This is trade math, not an NEC rule. Check your bender's marks before you bend."

positive.prompt: Open the Ask Shorty app so I can practice for the exam.
positive.expected_behavior: The Ask Shorty app opens with Calculators and Exam prep tabs. Exam prep lists all 9 NEC chapters. Questions and explanations show section numbers, not code text.
